title: Manipal Group lifts Manipal Cigna stake to 71%
body: Manipal Group has acquired an additional 20% stake in Manipal Cigna Health Insurance Company from its joint venture partner Cigna Corporation, taking its holding to 71%. Manipal held 51% and Cigna 49% before the transaction, which leaves Cigna with 29%. Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted for Manipal Group, Khaitan & Co advised Cigna Corporation, and Trilegal advised the lenders financing the purchase.
